evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want me to take note of at this time?" — asked after rooms/boxes/walking-distance probing was already done
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: "In the past, I've had to move myself and moving the mattress was the hardest thing" — rep answered with the weight-limit and equipment policy but didn't dig further into what else worried him
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "we only charge in fifteen minute increments" (beats-it-pay-less) + walking-distance-driven range framing (window) — two of five lines present

top_strength: Took a hard price objection ("it's not that much stuff") gracefully without getting defensive or pushy, keeping the door open for a future call.
coaching_note: Never got to a close because the price reaction landed right after the estimate — a stronger Save Your Ass (especially the self-prep tip and a genuine "does that feel fair" pause) before stating the dollar figure might have softened this particular price-shock moment.
